mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 9.5) signals weak labor market conditions and economic stagnation, which depresses corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 100.5) signals expanding manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO > 100.5 during expansionary manufacturing cycles.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A high annualized inflation rate (CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.5%) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion (HOUST > 570) signals increased consumer confidence and spending, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 570 during housing market expansion.
